Class BodyElementsPublisher<T>

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.http.body.stream.BodyElementsPublisher<T>
Type Parameters:
T - The type of an element
All Implemented Interfaces:
Publisher<T>, Subscription
@Internal public final class BodyElementsPublisher<T> extends Object implements Publisher<T>, Subscription
BodyElements as a publisher, without Reactor: the requested elements that are available at once (BodyElements.poll()) are emitted in a loop, the others with one BodyElements.next() at a time. Cancellation and terminal signals close the elements.

One subscriber.

Since:
5.3.0
